results.title: Claude Meetings: how to use it, pricing and alternatives
results.content:
These categories overlap. Live questions and work beyond a transcript already exist elsewhere. Compare the assistant’s audience, source access, review effort and output destination against your actual workflow. An existing meeting archive or administration system may matter more than an extra generation feature.

## Troubleshooting and limits

Meetings is missing or Claude cannot join. Work through the setup above: workspace access, organization and role settings, Calendar authentication, guest policy and host admission. Then consult the current help page for rollout status or contact support. Repeating invitations will not resolve an organization restriction. [...] The answer or action list is wrong. Compare it with the transcript, ask participants to confirm disputed points and edit the deliverable. If the transcript itself is wrong, another generated summary of it will not repair the evidence. For a connected-file answer, check the source, date and permissions as well as the result.

Anthropic specifies an eight-hour maximum per meeting.

We found no published fixed monthly meeting-hour quota, Meetings-specific language list, country-by-country rollout list, accuracy benchmark or response-time guarantee in the reviewed materials. Treat those as unanswered questions rather than promises about universal support.

## Who should try it? [...] ## Privacy, guests and administrator controls

Saved meeting materials can contain confidential details even without an audio file. Agree on capture, check who can open the output, and decide when to pause before a sensitive discussion. A visible assistant does not settle those decisions for the group.

The launch article describes excluding external calls by default. The operational guide instead says external guests default to allowed on Team and internal-only on Enterprise. These statements conflict. Have an owner inspect the actual workspace setting before a customer call.

Where allowed, guests’ speech enters the notes, but guests receive neither the internal meeting page nor recap email. Claude does not answer in external Meet chat.

results.content:
It is genuinely disappointing to see a service that I previously enjoyed become this frustrating to use.  
  
For the price you charge, I expect significantly better functionality, flexibility, and customer experience.  
  
Goodbye, Claude. You have lost a paying customer. [...] Evaluating 1,153 reviews, most reviewers were let down by their experience overall. People frequently encountered frustrating issues with unexpected subscription charges, sudden account blocks, and confusing purchasing processes. Reviewers also noted that the artificial intelligence often forgets previous instructions, drops important project details, and wastes a significant amount of time. Furth ermore, consumers complained about unresponsive support teams and strict usage limits that severely hindered their daily work. Some reviewers were happy with the platform, mentioning that it saved them hours of work and provided exceptionally good coding assistance.
